## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to model per-tenant gating with latency awareness, using a sidecar to maintain state and a centralized store, plus end-to-end validation.

## Key Concepts
- Tenant-scoped health gate with per-tenant state
- Latency-aware 5xx degradation trigger
- Redis-backed counters and cooldown semantics
- Status exposure endpoints and lightweight validation

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal ConfigMap for thresholds
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf-health-config
  namespace: cnf
data:
  latencyThresholdMs: "300"
  windowSeconds: "120"
  consecutiveFailures: "2"
```

```yaml
# Minimal test deployment with gateway and sidecar
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: cnf
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: cnf/gateway:latest
      - name: tenant-health-sidecar
        image: cnf/tenant-health-sidecar:latest
        env:
        - name: REDIS_HOST
          value: redis.cnf.svc.cluster.local
        - name: NAMESPACE
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace
```

```yaml

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: cnf
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates candidate understanding of tenant-scoped dynamic capability negotiation and caching in cloud-native environments, ensuring isolation and correctness at scale.

## Key Concepts

- Tenant-scoped capability registry (implemented as a CRD or ConfigMap)
- Per-tenant, TTL-based cache in the sidecar for performance optimization
- Highest common version selection using semantic versioning
- HTTP 406 Not Acceptable response when no compatible version exists; graceful default fallback
- Observability: Prometheus metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing

## Code Example

```go
// Pseudocode for version negotiation
func negotiate(upstreamVersions []string, tenantID string) string {
    tenantVersions := registry.GetVersions(tenantID)
    allowed := intersect(upstreamVersions, tenantVersions)
    if len(allowed) == 0 {
        return DEFAULT_VERSION
    }
    return highestVersion(allowed)
}
```

## Implementation Highlights

- Extract X-TENANT-ID header in sidecar middleware
- Query central registry for tenant capabilities
- Compute intersection with upstream supported versions
- Select highest compatible version using semver comparison
- Store result in tenant-scoped cache with configurable TTL
- Return 406 if negotiation fails and no default is configured
- Emit histogram metrics for negotiation latency and cache hit rates

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates advanced telemetry architecture, per-tenant observability, dynamic sampling strategies, and operational safety practices for CNF gateways at scale.

## Key Concepts
- OpenTelemetry, OTLP, trace context propagation, and baggage
- Namespace-scoped configuration and feature flags
- Adaptive sampling policies with latency-aware thresholds
- Canary rollouts and rollback safety

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf.trace
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  cnf.trace.enabled: "true"
  cnf.trace.sample-rate: "0.25"
  cnf.trace.target: "otel-collector.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local:4317"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cnf-gateway
        image: cnf-gateway:latest
        env:
        - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: cnf.trace
              key: cnf.trace.target
      - name: otel-collector
        image: otel/collector:latest
        args: ["--config=/etc/otel/config.yaml"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: otel-config
          mountPath: /etc/otel
      volumes:
      - name: otel-config
        configMap:
          name: otel-collector-config
```

## Adaptive Sampling Implementation
```go
func AdaptiveSampler(sampleRate float64, errorRate float64) float64 {
    baseRate := sampleRate
    if errorRate > 0.05 {
        return min(1.0, baseRate*2)
    }
    return baseRate
}
```

## Rollout Strategy
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 5
      - pause: {duration: 5m}
      analysis:
        templates:
        - templateName: error-rate-check
        successfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
        failedRunHistoryLimit: 3
```
